scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
issuing_authority: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
target_group: Economically vulnerable families identified through SECC and NFSA criteria requiring secondary and tertiary healthcare

eligibility_rules.description: Possesses an Aadhaar card or verified enrolment number
No family member is an active income tax payee
No family member is a regular government or PSU employee with CGHS/ECHS coverage
Annual family income up to Rs 2,50,000 per year

benefits.instalments: Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals

required_documents: Ration Card (Food Security Card / White Ration Card)
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit the Ayushman Beneficiary Portal at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / Ayushman Mitra at a government hospital
Enter mobile number and authenticate via Aadhaar OTP to check family inclusion
Verify family member details and complete biometric e-KYC
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) for instant cashless treatment
source_document: AB-PMJAY Operational Guidelines, National Health Authority
